steps.summary: Signed in to Grafana with admin/admin (no change-password prompt appeared), navigated to the "Service health" dashboard, and observed all panels. The dashboard displays 3 panels: "Request rate", "Error count", and "Latency by endpoint".
Replayed stored procedure s_369723; observed panel_title=fwgr21-n3 Availability, dashboard_title=fwgr21-n3 Bench Dashboard.
Replayed stored procedure s_070654; observed panel_titles=fwgr21-n3 Availability, dashboard_title=fwgr21-n3 Bench Dashboard.

Added a new Text panel "fwgr21-n3 Notes" to the dashboard with content "Bench run fwgr21-n3 — notes panel". Saved the dashboard successfully (confirmed by "Dashboard saved" alert). The dashboard now shows 2 panels: "fwgr21-n3 Notes" (Text panel with the specified content) and "fwgr21-n3 Availability" (Stat panel).
Replayed stored procedure s_db792f; observed time_range=Last 6 hours.

Set the auto-refresh interval to '1m' by opening the time range picker/refresh dropdown and selecting '1 minute'. Saved the dashboard with 'Update default refresh value' checked; a 'Dashboard saved' toast appeared. Then reloaded the page fresh. The auto-refresh control shows '1m' next to the refresh icon (button "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected"), and the time range picker shows 'Last 6 hours'.
Replayed stored procedure s_8ffa4a; observed dashboard_title=fwgr21-n3 Bench Dashboard, time_range=Last 6 hours, auto_refresh_interval=1m, read9=fwgr21-n3 Notes, read10=fwgr21-n3 Availability.

Opened 'fwgr21-n3 Availability' panel in edit mode: it is a **Stat** visualization using the **TestData** data source (query dropdown shows "TestData", query row labelled "A (TestData)"). Clicked Back to return. The 'fwgr21-n3 Notes' panel displays text: "Bench run fwgr21-n3 — notes panel".
